Commentary.Commentary: So, Sri Lanka have booked a place in the final and the last league game of the tournament between Zimbabwe and West Indies becomes a straight shootout. Let's hope we have another cracking contest. Do join us for that game on 25th November at 1300 IST. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!
There were plenty of candidates for this but KUSAL MENDIS has been awarded the MAN OF THE MATCH for his enterprising knock.

WI needed 10 runs in the last over this time and a six from Benn made it 3 in 3 but Pradeep held his nerve to see his side through by a whisker. Sri Lanka will know they got out of jail here but they won't mind it at all, it secures their place in the tri-series final. The game between Zimbabwe and West Indies now becomes a knockout game.

Carlos Brathwaite shared a 45-run stand with Jason Holder but both of them preferred to play the risk free game and eventually ended up leaving it a bit too late. Brathwaite departed to Kulasekara who was impressive with his yorkers. Jason Holder batted through but could not get his team over the line in what was another last over finish for them.

West Indies were cruising in the game thanks to the 148 by Evin Lewis who came out hammering right from the start of the game and it kept them in the hunt. There was not much swing, spin on offer for the Lankans and he along with Charles gave them the perfect start. Wickets did fall to direct hits but he held one end and ensured West Indies had a great platform to push for the win.

Phew! What a game of cricket! Sri Lanka have won the game by a whisker here! Tremendous fight from the Windies though. 659 runs scored but it came down to the last ball to decide the winner, such is the game of cricket at times. West Indies will feel they have not won two games they should have.

THE LANKANS HAVE DONE IT! What a ball from Nuwan Pradeep. Fires a yorker on middle and off, Holder digs it out towards the cover region and can only manage a single. How unfortunate for the Windies, they put up a really good fight. SRI LANKA WIN BY 1 RUN!
SHANNON GABRIEL is the last man in. He won't be on strike though. Can Holder finish with a boundary?

OUT! BENN DEPARTS! Full and outside off, Sulieman Benn hits this flat over covers. He doesn't get the distance on it and it's good catch by Dhananjaya de Silva out in the deep. West Indies need 3 runs off the final delivery.
Fires it full and well outside off, Benn looks to squeeze it out on the off side but misses. 3 off 2 now.

SIX! Sulieman Benn with a big, big hit. Short of a length on middle and off, Benn makes a little room and pulls this hard. Gets it right off the middle of the bat and sends it miles over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum. 3 needed off 3 now.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length delivery angled across, Sulieman Benn walks down the track and looks to heave it across the line but misses it completely.
Yorker on middle and leg, Holder gets an inside edge down to fine leg as he looks to dig it out. Only a single is taken.
NUWAN PRADEEP to bowl the final over of the game. 10 needed in 6 balls!
Full on middle and leg, it's hit down to long on for a single.
WIDE! Seeing Holder make room, Lakmal follows him but ends up spearing it too far down the leg side. Wide signalled.
Fired in full on the pads, Holder flicks it through to deep square leg and runs hard to come back for the second. He is successful in doing so. Great running between the wickets.
Full on middle and leg, Benn flicks it towards mid-wicket and hares to the other end to complete a quick single.

FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! Cutter around off, Sulieman Benn just looks to push it timidly inside the line and ends up getting an edge through the vacant slip cordon. It races away to the third man fence as West Indies now need 15 more to win off 9 deliveries.
SULIEMANN BENN is the new man in.

OUT! Was there an edge? Yes, there was. Full ball on leg, Ashley Nurse goes for the big slog but ends up missing it, at least it seems so. It goes behind as the keeper takes it. Sri Lanka appeal for a caught behind and after this, the umpire has a long chat with the square leg umpire. They think hard about it and then the decision goes upstairs. Replays confirm there was an edge and Nurse has to make the long walk back. 19 still required off 10 balls.
Big moment this, the umpire thinks Ashley Nurse is caught behind. It is referred upstairs to confirm the same.
Seeing Jason Holder making room, Lakmal follows this with a full ball. It goes off Holder's pads as he looks to flick it across the line. A leg bye is taken.

Ashley Nurse dances down the track and it's a high full toss from Kulasekara. He looks to heave it across the line and ends up getting a bottom edge down towards fine leg. Two runs are taken. 20 runs needed off the last 2 overs.
Makes a little room this time and drives it to mid off. Scurries to the other end and completes the run.
Full on middle and off, Holder drives it hard but it's straight to the cover fielder.
Full on the pads, it goes off the pads as Nurse looks to flick it across the line. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls to the mid-wicket area.
ASHLEY NURSE walks in to bat.

OUT! You miss, I hit, says Kulasekara! Bowls a stump-to-stump line and fires it full on middle, Brathwaite goes for the big slog but misses the ball completely. The stumps are rattled and that's an important wicket for the Lankans. 24 more needed off 16.
Full toss swinging in on the pads, whipped to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Takes the pace off it and bowls a slower length ball outside off, Holder runs it to short third man and scampers to the other end to complete the run. 25 needed from 18 now.
Full toss on the pads, flicked through square leg for one easy run.
Full toss on middle and off, hit down to long off by Jason Holder for a run.
Slower length delivery from Lakmal, Brathwaite shuffles across and works it through square leg. Thinks of taking the second but then decides against it.
This one has gone quicker to Mendis at deep mid-wicket. So, only a single is taken this time.
Full and fired in on middle and leg, Jason Holder flicks it through the big gap in the mid-wicket region and gets two runs for it.
LAKMAL returns for a bowl.
Carlos comes down the track and takes it on the full, hits it through to deep mid-wicket for a single. 32 needed off 24 balls.

Nicely done by Kulasekara as he follows Holder when he makes room. It's hit down to long on and the batsmen take the fielder on. They go for the second run and get it too. Excellent running between the wickets.
Keeps it on the fuller side, it's on middle and off, this time Holder drives it covers. Another dot ball.
Dot ball. It's fired in full on off, it's driven square to point. No run taken.
Full on the pads, it's worked through mid-wicket for another run.
Full on middle and leg, Jason Holder drives it towards the long on fielder and gets himself to the other end to bring Carlos Brathwaite on strike.
High full toss on middle and leg, it's hit through to deep mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
Full toss on off, hit straight back to the bowler.
Full toss on leg, Brathwaite picks it off his pads and clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fired full and outside off, Brathwaite defends it in front of covers.
WIDE! Maybe a bit harsh. Carlos Brathwaite moves across to clip it but misses. Umpire calls it a wide. Was quite close, that.
Fuller ball swinging in on middle and leg, Holder hits it down to long on and picks up a single for it.
Spears in a full ball on middle and leg, it's hit down to wide long on for a couple of runs. Good running between the wickets.
NUWAN PRADEEP comes back on to bowl.
Yorker on middle and leg, it's drilled down to long on for a single. West Indies need 43 to win from 36 deliveries.
Another attempted yorker, on leg stump, it's worked through mid-wicket for a single. Wanted the second but the fielder out in the deep does well to stop them from doing so.
Good comeback by Kulasekara. Bowls a brilliant yorker on middle and off, Brathwaite does well to bring his bat down in time and jam it out.
Full on middle and leg, it's wristed towards wide long on for two quick runs.
WIDE! Going down leg, wide called.
They have lost the ball and the umpire asks for a replacement ball.

SIX! THAT'S OUT OF THE PARK! What a monstrous hit. Slower one from Kulasekara but Carlos picks it up. He gets big on the ball and smokes it back down. Clears the long on fence, in fact, he hits it out of the park. Gets a biggie to his name. That ball isn't coming back any time soon.
Fuller length ball on the stumps, flicked with the wrists through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another full ball on the stumps, hit back down the ground for another run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full on middle and leg, it's eased down to long off for a single.
Outside off, it's run down to third man for a single.
Full around off, Holder gets low and smashes it down to long off for a run.

IN THE AIR.... BUT IT'S PUT DOWN! How can you even do that at such a time, Upul Tharanga? He's put down such a simple chance. Gunaratne with a slower one well outside off, Carlos Brathwaite reaches out to it and looks to go big down the ground. Skies the top edge towards mid on where Tharanga runs behind a few steps and makes a horrible mess of it. A single is taken.
Full toss on middle and leg, it's flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery aimed at the base of off stump, Jason Holder drives it back down towards mid off for a single.
Good yorker. Gets it right this time and Brathwaite does well to keep it out. Digs it out towards mid-wicket for a quick run.
Full toss on off, it's hit through towards wide long off for a single.
WIDE! Another attempted leg stump yorker which just misses. Another wide signalled.
WIDE! Fired in full but it's going down leg, wide called by the umpire.
An attempted yorker which goes wrong, becomes a full toss on middle and off. No harm done as Jason Holder hits it back to Lakmal.
Fuller length ball outside off, Holder misses as he looks to drive it through the covers. Lakmal starts off with a dot.
SURANGA LAKMAL is back on to bowl.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length outside off, played to backward point for nothing.
Full on the stumps, it's driven back down the ground for a single.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE comes out to bat.

OUT! EVIN LEWIS IS GONE! But not before playing a blinder of a knock. He plays this length ball towards mid off and sets off for the single. Holder is ball watching and doesn't respond to the call. Evin has to rush back but is unable to beat the throw. Dickwella removes the bails and that's the end of the southpaw opener. He departs on 148. 69 needed to win off 57 balls.
Fullish in length outside off, Lewis fails to connect the sweep.
Angles across a length ball, Lewis backs away and cuts it late down to short third man. An overthrow allows the batsmen to come back for the second. Sloppy from the Lankans.
ASELA GUNARATNE returns for a spell.
Powerplay 3 is signaled. Now 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.

SIX! Back of a length delivery on off, Holder picks up the length early and positions himself quickly. Rocks back and pulls it hard over mid-wicket sending it sailing into the stands. 71 needed to win in 60 balls.
Fullish in length, it's played back to the bowler. Dot ball.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Evin with a back foot punch through the covers. One run taken.
Slower one from Pradeep, it's on a length on off as Holder stays behind the line. Gently taps it on the off side and a brisk single is taken.
Length delivery outside off, Holder punches it off his back foot through to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Back of a length on off, Jason Holder leans forward a bit, opens the face of the bat and taps it away to short third man.
The physio is out to treat Evin Lewis. The left-hander is struggling with a pulled hamstring. PRADEEP returns for a bowl.

SIX! He's middled that. Full on middle and leg, Lewis picks it up and goes for it. Gets low to it and slog sweeps it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. WI need 81 to win off 66 deliveries.

Fuller around off, some drift on that occasion, Holder pushes it in front of short cover and sets off for the single. Lewis makes it at the other end but that's dangerous living from the Windies skipper. His main man has already pulled a muscle.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Lewis punches it down to long off for a single.
Full outside off, Evin Lewis drives it through the cover region and picks up a couple of runs.
Big swing and a miss! Flatter and fired across, Lewis kneels down and looks for the big slog sweep but misses it completely.
FOUR! That's whacked away first ball of the over. Great start to the over. It's full and in the slot, Evin Lewis clears his front leg and slogs it hard over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
Yes, he can. Top, top stuff. He arrows another full delivery on the stumps, Holder can only hit it back to the bowler.

One more yorker speared on the off pole, Evin gets an inside edge down towards short fine leg as he swings his bat at this. A quick run is taken. Great over so far. Can Kulasekara end it on a positive note?
Nuwan Kulasekara with another excellent yorker. Evin Lewis manages to jam it out but will not get any run for it.
Fuller length ball outside off, no trouble for Jason Holder to drive it through to deep cover for a run.
Excellent yorker from Kulasekara, on middle and leg, Evin Lewis squeezes it out down to long on for a single.
Full toss outside off, Lewis throws his bat at this and gets a thick outside edge. It goes behind straight to the short third man fielder.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Jason Holder slams it through the covers for a boundary. Bad end to the over from Pathirana. Wasted all the pressure applied till now.
Another dot ball as Holder works it to the left of the short mid-wicket fielder.
Shorter and sliding in on middle and off, it's whipped to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Short and flat outside off, Lewis punches it down to long off for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes from around the wicket and darts it on the stumps, Holder prods forward but ends up getting an inside edge to the leg side as he attempts to block.
PATHIRANA is back on.
Fuller ball aiming the base of off stump, Jason Holder stands tall and drives it back past the bowler. A misfield from the fielder at mid off allows the batsmen to take a single.
JASON HOLDER comes out to bat.

OUT! POWELL IS GONE! Kulasekara is the man who's got the breakthrough. He comes running in and fires in a yorker on middle and leg, Powell looks to dig it out but fails to do so. Is rapped on the pads as a loud appeal goes around. The umpire raises his finger but Rovman reviews the decision. Much to his dismay, replays show the ball to be hitting leg stump. He's gone and that's an important wicket for Sri Lanka.
Rovman Powell has been given out on an LBW decision. He isn't convinced though and decides to take a review against the decision.
Full toss on middle and off, Rovman Powell hits it straight back to the bowler.
Pitched just ahead of a length, outside off, Evin Lewis slaps it back down to long off for a run.
Fuller length ball around off, it's hit to the cover region for a quick single.
Fires it full on middle stump, Powell slogs this hard through the mid-wicket region. The fielder from wide long on runs to his right and cuts the ball off, keeping the batsmen down to two.
NUWAN KULASEKARA is brought back into the attack.
Spears in a yorker on middle and leg, Lewis fails to clip it through. West Indies need 111 more runs in 90 balls.
Works it towards square leg off the inside half of the bat for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards point from the crease.
Angled on a length on off, played back to the bowler from his crease.
Good length outside off, dabbed towards point from the crease.
Bowls it outside leg, tucked towards the leg side for a single.

Top effort! Lewis slams one down the ground where the long off fielder comes across and keeps them to a run. Third umpire referred to check if it was a boundary but the replays show the fielder was clean there.
FOUR! Lewis on the charge! Bowls it on middle, Lewis gets across and pulls it through fine leg for a boundary. Lewis is struggling with cramps too it seems.
Lewis tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single. He strolls for it and there is a direct hit at the striker's end and they get another single. Poor from SL!
FOUR! Shorter outside off, Lewis cuts it hard through covers for a powerful boundary.

NOT OUT! Oh dear, Dickwella what have you done! Powell punches it towards covers from his crease and looks for a quick single. There is another direct hit from covers at the striker's end and it is referred upstairs. Replays show that the batsman is again short of the crease but the keeper disturbed the stumps with his gloves first. What a reprieve for Lewis and Sri Lanka continue to give lives to the southpaw. Is this  the game for the Lankans?
Another direct hit. This time it's Lewis on the danger end. It's gone to the third umpire.
Fires it on the pads, Powell fails to clip it. The ball goes off the pads down to fine leg. They cross for a couple of leg byes.
Good length on middle tucked towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! EDGED! Outside off on a length, Powell gets an outside edge which runs down to the third man fence for a boundary to get off the mark.
Bowls it outside off, Powell gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Pushes this one back down the wicket for a single.
ROVMAN POWELL comes into the attack.

OUT! Another direct hit! Shorter outside off, Lewis pulls it towards mid on from his crease. They look for a single but there is a direct hit at the bowler's end as Lewis refuses the single and sends Carter back. It is referred upstairs. Replays shows that was a marginal call and Tharanga from mid on has struck gold. Second direct hit and Carter has to go back.
A run out appeal against Jonathan Carter is referred upstairs by the umpire. It looks tight.
SIX! TOP EDGED! Shorter length on middle, Lewis goes for the pull but gets a top edge which flies down to the fine leg fence.
WIDE! Slants it across on a shorter length, Lewis lets it go. A wide signaled.
PRADEEP comes back on for a bowl.
DRINKS BREAK!
Lewis plays it through mid off for a single. West Indies need 140 more runs in 108 balls.
Lewis goes for the sweep but misses it completely.

FOUR! In the gap! Bowls it fuller on middle, Lewis goes for the slog. He gets it off the top edge towards deep square leg where Pradeep over runs the ball and the ball goes over him for a boundary. Pradeep should have been on the fence there.
Shorter outside off, Carter works it down to long on for a single.
Carter stays back and pushes it towards point.
Shorter outside off, punched down to long off for a single.
EDGED! Outside off, Carter gets an outside edge down to third man. Kulasekara dives and stops the ball in time. Two runs taken.
Shorter outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Another leg stump line length ball, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Shorter length on middle and leg, Lewis looks to pull but misses. That was close to being called a wide.
Carter gets off the mark with a dab to third man.
Loud shout for an lbw but not given! Angled on the stumps, Lewis fails to clip it through. Loud shout for lbw but that looked like pitching outside leg right from the start. Leg bye taken.
Maiden ODI ton for Evin Lewis!

TON! Well played, Lewis! Stays back and punches it through covers for a single. That brings up his ton. He removes his helmet and raises his bat to acknowledge the applause. West Indies need 154 more in 120 balls.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side for a wide.
Bowls it on middle, Lewis punches it back down the wicket. The bowler gets a hand to it and deflects it onto the stumps and appeals but no harm done.
JONATHAN CARTER is the next batsman in.

OUT! DIRECT HIT TAKES OUT HOPE! On the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single. He calls for the second but it is a risky one. Pradeep scores a direct hit from the deep at the bowler's end. The commentator on air says that is out and the replays confirm the same. Hope has to go.
A run out decision against Shai Hope is referred upstairs.
Misfield! Length ball that is played back down the wicket. The bowler fumbles and allows a single.
Shorter on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, worked through mid on for a single.
Good length on off, Hope punches it towards mid on for a quick single.
Angled on a length, tucked towards mid-wicket from his crease.
FOUR! Thumped! Fuller outside off, this time Hope crashes it through covers for a boundary. That was hit on the up by Hope.
Places this one towards point from his crease but cannot take a single.
BEATEN! Outside off on a length, Hope looks to play it through covers but is beaten all ends up.
Good length outside off, punched towards mid off by Hope.
SURANGA LAKMAL comes back on for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, Lewis mistimes his cut towards covers.
Fuller on middle, Lewis keeps it out from his crease.
Works it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on off, punched towards the on side from his crease.
Comes in with the arm on off, played towards mid on from his crease.
Angled on the stumps, Hope paddles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Comes forward and pushes it towards covers from his crease. West Indies need 168 more in 23 overs!
FOUR! In the gap! Lewis goes for the sweep and gets it through backward square leg for a boundary. He moves on to 97!
Outside off, pushed towards covers for a quick single.
FOUR! Superb shot! Fuller outside off, Hope gets under it and crashes it through covers for a boundary. That's nicely hit!
On off, played back through the bowler for a single. He moves on to 93!
Floated outside off, pushed towards covers from his crease.
Fuller on the pads, turned towards mid-wicket from his crease for a single.
Fuller on off, played down the ground through long on for a single.
Angled on off, Hope turns it towards short mid-wicket from his crease.
Fuller outside off, hit back towards the bowler who stops it in his followthrough.
Yorker on middle, Hope digs it out in time.
Turning in sharply from outside off, Shai Hope stays deep in his crease and punches it back in the direction of the bowler.
FOUR! In the gap! Outside off, Lewis stays back and cuts it hard through covers for a boundary. Superb shot, that!
Stays back and defends this one.
Stays back and punches it to covers.
Takes a single towards long off from his crease.
Lewis slices it through covers for a single.
Plays this one back to the bowler.
Another punch that goes to the fielder.
Pushed towards mid on from the crease by Hope.
Shorter outside off, Hope goes back and pulls it down the ground. Long on comes across and stops the ball from going through. A couple taken.
Outside off, Lewis punches it through mid on for a single.
Drives it for a single to the off side.
Angles it outside off, Hope whips it through the on side.
Floated on middle, Hope comes forward and defends it off the inside edge towards backward square leg. A run taken.
Tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Lewis comes down to have a go but he slices it over Pradeep at covers. Two runs taken. Pressure beginning to say?
Stays back and cuts it through point for a single.
Works it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Floated on off, Hope comes forward and defends it.
Hope works it through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Outside off, Hope defends it.
Good length outside off, Hope keeps it out.
SHAI HOPE comes in to bat.

OUT! ASELA STRIKES! Slips this one on a fuller length outside off, comes in sharply, Brathwaite throws his bat at it but fails to connect. The ball disturbs the stumps and that is it for Kraigg. At first it seemed like there was an inside edge which was caught behind but replays confirmed it was bowled.
Fuller on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Bowls it outside off, cut through covers for a single.
ASELA GUNARATNE into the attack.
Outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Comes forward and pushes it to covers from his crease.
Pushes it to covers adn looks for a single but it is not on
Too full outside off, Brathwaite looks to drive but is beaten all ends up.
Stays back and cuts it towards backward point.
Floated on middle, Brathwaite comes forward and defends it.
Lewis stands his ground and lofts it over the cover region for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Lucky runs for Evin Lewis. He rocks back to this back of a length delivery and gets a bottom edge as he looks to pull. It goes past the off pole and past the diving keeper. Races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Tight line as Pradeep bowls it on a back of a length and just around off, Lewis keeps it out off the back foot and into the track ahead.
Length ball angling in on middle and leg, it's worked to the leg side for a run.
WIDE! Fires this down the leg side on a fuller length, easy call for the umpire to signal a wide.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Brathwaite walks across a step, opens the face and dabs it straight to the man at point.
On a good length and angled across, it's hit behind point for a single.
No, they can't. It's flat and sliding in, Kraigg gets an inside edge onto his pads as he goes back to whip it across the line.
Full outside off, it's whacked to long off for another run. Can they make it 6 in 6?
Keeping the scoreboard ticking here as Kraigg Brathwaite pushes it back down to long off for one more.
Flatter ball on the pads, Evin sweeps it away through to deep backward square leg for a run.
Full and darted outside off, it's eased down to long off for one.
Evin Lewis takes a step down and hits it down to long on for a single.
SACHITH PATHIRANA comes into the attack.
Kraigg Brathwaite drills this fuller length ball towards mid on and ends the over with that.
Stays behind to this length delivery and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Bit fuller in length and this time it's on the stumps, it's worked in front of mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Lewis lofts it over the cover region for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, Evin Lewis stays back and punches it to the left of the bowler.
Full on middle and off, it's driven back down to long off for a single.
Another back foot punch from the southpaw on the off side. No run taken.
Close. It's sliding in from around off, the pace almost takes Lewis by surprise. He still somehow manages to punch it out off the back foot to cover.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and darted in on off, it's pushed to the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Uses the depth of the crease well and puts it away. Sliding in on a shorter length from around off, Lewis backs away and crunches the punch through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
Keeps low and it's pitched outside leg once more. Lewis pulls it down to fine leg for one run.
FOUR! THAT'S SMASHED! Length ball outside off, Evin stands firm and murders it through extra cover to send it all the way.
Loud lbw appeal which is turned down. It's pitches outside leg again so it doesn't matter even if the impact is in line. Lewis swivels across to pull but misses.
Sprays this on the pads, it's turned through square leg for a run.

Back of a length ball angled across, Evin Lewis hangs back and punches it towards covers. The fielder there dives to his right and stops the ball from going past him. Restricts the batsmen to just a single.
A bit on the shorter side as it's pitched outside off, Kraigg stays back and punches it through to sweeper cover for a single.
DRINKS BREAK!
Fuller on off, hit back to the bowler who fumbles and allows a single to mid on.
Tossed up outside off, Brathwaite looks to turn it through the on side but the bowler goes to his right and stops it.
Fuller on off, driven to long off for a single.
Turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, played back to the bowler who goes to his right and stops it.
Floated outside off, smashed to deep cover for a single.
Back of a length delivery angling across, Evin Lewis off his back foot punches it to covers for a single.
Fuller length ball around off, Lewis lofts this over the covers and gets a couple of runs for it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

NOT OUT! That's pitched outside the line which has saved the southpaw. Pradeep comes running in and bowls a back of a length delivery. It keeps low and hits Evin Lewis on the pads as he is unable to bring his bat down on the ball. The umpire raises his finger but the left-hander takes a review against the decision. And what a good review it is. Replays show the ball to be pitching outside the line of leg stump. Lewis survives!
Lewis is given out lbw. He goes up to Brathwaite, has a chat, punches gloves, then takes his time to signal for the review.
Just back of a length on off stump, Evin Lewis stays behind the line and keeps it down on the track with a straight blade.
Angles in a full ball on middle and leg, Kraigg Brathwaite works it off his pads and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Darted on the stumps, it's hit straight back to the bowler.
On the fuller side once more, Evin Lewis drills it towards the wide long off fielder and picks up a single.
Comes from around the wicket now and tosses it up outside off, it's dug out to the cover fielder for no run.
Full on the stumps, it's eased down to long on for one.
Full on middle and leg, it's clipped down towards fine leg for two good runs.

Length ball on the pads, it's tucked towards fine leg. Lewis runs hard for the first one and instantly calls for the second. Brilliant running between the wickets allows him to complete the second run with ease. Great stuff!
Aims the thigh pad and hits the target as well as Evin Lewis misses his big pull shot.
Pitches this just back of a length and around off, Evin hangs back and pushes it out on the off side.
On a good length and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite opens the face of the bat and steers it down towards third man for a run.
Maiden ODI fifty for Evin Lewis!
Fifty for Lewis. Nicely done. He works this length ball through mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Length ball outside off, Lewis stays back and plays it towards point.
NUWAN PRADEEP is brought into the attack.
Full ball aimed at the base of off stump, it's pushed down to long off for a single. Moves on to 49 with that.
Full on the stumps, it's driven back down the ground. Kulasekara from long off comes inside and puts in a good dive to cut it off. Two runs are taken.
On a flatter trajectory outside off, Evin Lewis with an open face pushes it to the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Attacks the stumps this time, Evin Lewis comes forward and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Fuller around off, Lewis plays this off the outer half towards covers.
WIDE! Starts off with a wide from around the wicket as he slides it down the leg side. Lewis goes for the sweep but misses.
SHEHAN JAYASURIYA introduced into the attack.
Powerplay 2 is signaled. A good first one for West Indies.
On a length on off, turned through mid-wicket by Brathwaite. Interestingly, this is West Indies' highest score against Sri Lanka in Powerplay 1!
Outside off on a length, Lewis fails to punch it cleanly, he gets an outside edge that dies down behind him. The ball goes through the keeper for a single.
Length ball outside off, punched towards mid off from the crease by Lewis.
Slower one outside off, Lewis looks to flay it through but is beaten.
Good length outside off, punched towards covers.
FOUR! Through the fielder! Fuller on off, Lewis goes for another slap through mid on. Pradeep goes to his right, leaps across but the ball flies through his hands for a boundary.
Pushes this one towards mid off from his crease.
Good length outside off, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, keeps a tad low, Lewis gets a leading edge through mid off for a run.
Length ball on off, defended back down the wicket.
FOUR! Lovely batting! Lewis is ensuring the Windies are not losing any momentum. He unfurls a lovely straight drive through mid off for a boundary.
SIX! SHOT! Shorter on middle, Lewis goes for the hook and gets it over backward square leg for a maximum.
KRAIGG BRATHWAITE is the new man in.

OUT! One too many and Charles departs! Slower one again from Lakmal, this time Charles goes for another drive but this time through mid off but finds Tharanga stationed there. End of a fruitful opening stand. Charles departs after a start again.
FOUR! JUST OVER! Charles gets under this length ball on middle, swivels and pulls it through short fine leg for a boundary. That was not far from the man at short fine.
FOUR! Charles on the charge! Slower one, Charles picks it though and drives it back down the ground for a boundary. Superb timing!
Edged! Shorter outside off, Charles gets a bottom edge on his cut shot towards square leg.
Ouch! Bowls it on a good length on off, comes in, Charles looks to heave it but is hit on his thigh.
Dabs it towards the off side for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, played back to the bowler by Charles.

Sloppy from Sri Lanka! Fuller outside off, Lewis pushes it towards mid off and takes a single. Vandersay (the substitute) misfields and allows a couple of runs. There is a run out chance but the throw comes in at the bowler's end. Charles was in his own mind as the throw was then returned at the striker's end too. Could have been close!
Gets the yorker right, Charles clips it to mid on and takes off for a quick single. The throw comes in at the non-striker's end but misses. Charles had made it in.
On a length on off, Charles mistimes it back down the wicket.
SIX! TONK! Fuller on off, he expected the slower one, he comes down and swings it over mid-wicket for a maximum. That went 93m!
FOUR! CHIPPED! Low full toss, Charles does not go hard but gets enough on it to get it over mid on for a boundary. That came off the toe end of the bat.
WIDE! Slips one down the leg side for a wide.
Length ball outside off, played back down the wicket.
Dropped! Shorter outside off, Lewis cuts it hard towards backward point where the fielder goes to his right but cannot hold onto it, even on the second attempt. A chance gone!
Fuller on off and middle, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Bowls it on off, shapes away a touch, Charles defends it back.
Slip comes in at short cover. Square leg drops back.
FOUR! CRASHED! Fuller outside off, Charles get on top of that one and sends it hammering through wide mid off for a boundary.
Fuller on off, Charles looks to work it through but finds mid-wicket.
Outside off on a length, Lewis keeps it out from his crease with a back foot punch.
Charles heaves it through mid-wicket for another run.
Good stop! Lewis slaps  this through covers but the fielder dives and gets a hand to it. A single taken as the ball goes towards extra cover.
FOUR! TONK! Outside off, Lewis stays back and punches it through covers for a boundary. Superb shot, that!
Outside off, on a length, Lewis punches it back down the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Charles heaves it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Slashed! Fuller outside off, Lewis throws his bat at it and gets an outside edge down to the third man fence.
FOUR! Why slog when you can play these? Fuller on off, Lewis presents the full face of the bat and gets it back past the bowler for a boundary.
Lewis looks to go hard at this one but fails to find the gap at mid on.
IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! Lewis looks to flick one through but gets a top edge that evades the fielders running after it from covers. Two runs taken.
Stays in his crease and keeps it out.
Length ball outside off, punched towards covers by Lewis.
Outside off on a length, Charles comes down swinging at it but is beaten.
Inside edge saves Charles! Bowls it outside off, Charles looks to play his usual hoick over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Charles lets another one go through safely outside off.
Good length outside off, placed it towards covers.
On a length outside off, Lewis gets it off the inside edge through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off on a length, Lewis looks to punch it on the up but is beaten.
Another away swinger outside off, no shot offered.
Outside off on a length, Charles lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Charles.
Fuller on the stumps, Lewis gets across and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Hurls it on middle and leg, Lewis looks to clip it through but is hit on his pads. Another shout for lbw but that always looked high and that's why the umpire did not give it out.
FOUR! Top batting! Fuller on off, Lewis digs it out and slams it through mid off for a boundary. That was hit very straight and to the right of the umpire.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl from the other end.
Works this one through the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller on middle, Lewis clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a boundary to get off the mark.
On a length outside off, Lewis pushes it towards point.

NOT OUT! What a poor call to review! On a length angling into the stumps, Lewis looks to clip it through but is hit on his back leg as he was on the move with a hop. A loud appeal from the bowler but the umpire stays put. That looked out to the naked eye. Kulasekara convinces Tharanga for a review. Replays confirm there was no bat there. But sadly for Sri Lanka, it pitched outside leg and that is it. Sri Lanka lose their review! Teams need to start using reviews to overturn howlers and not marginal calls, since they only get one review per innings in ODIs.
Evin Lewis is caught leg before. He is adjudged not out but Sri Lanka have decided to take a review against the decision. It looks real close to the naked eye.
FIVE WIDES! Fuller and swinging down leg, Lewis looks to clip but it fails to connect as it swings further down the leg side.
Good length outside off, Lewis gets in line and defends it.
Begins with a length ball on middle, Charles looks to clip but is hit on his pads. A leg bye results.
Welcome back for the chase! JOHNSON CHARLES and EVIN LEWIS are out to open the batting for the Windies. Sri Lanka begin with NUWAN KULASEKARA! Here we go...
